source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #151 (Aboleth, the ten Adult dragons and Air Elemental; PDF pages 258–259, 264, 266–271, 276–277, 291–292, 294, 318–319, 324–325 and 340) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action and legendary action entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Amphibious. The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Eldritch Restoration
traits.text: Eldritch Restoration. If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mucus Cloud
traits.text: Mucus Cloud. While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target’s skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can’t regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.text: Probing Telepathy. If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Multiattack. The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

actions.name: Consume Memories
actions.text: Consume Memories. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The aboleth gains the target’s memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this action.

actions.name: Dominate Mind
actions.text: Dominate Mind (2/Day). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.
